name: Plutio
description: All-in-one app for freelancers (projects, proposals, contracts, invoices, forms).

mentions.evidence: ~$19.8k MRR, 898 subs, ~$1.48M all-time, ~16.8k users claimed, founded 2018.

whyThisMatters:
A freelancer usually keeps proposals in one app, contracts in another, invoices in a third. Plutio is that pile in one login. Clients, projects, forms, bookings, proposals, getting paid, and a way to hand work from one step to the next. Bookings are the extra the site puts up front.

They're pitching an assistant called Super Work AI. You ask it to draft a proposal, chase an invoice, or ping a client. Not a separate chat you paste text into. They say it runs on top of the projects and invoices you already keep there.

It's not only a browser tab. iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows. Templates. An API. A solo person can go from the first proposal to the payment on their phone.

You stay in one system instead of five tabs. That's the whole product. The assistant is just the new layer on top of the same pile.

The old setup is five logins and a note somewhere about which one has the contract. Here it's one login for the client, the proposal, the form, the booking, and the invoice. The assistant is the new layer. The pile of freelancer tools in one place is what people were already trying to pay for.
